scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy && npm run indexnow
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler versions upload --preview-alias preview
scripts.signals:build: astro build --root signals --force && node scripts/signals-check-build.ts && node scripts/signals-og.ts
scripts.signals:build:review: SIGNALS_NEWSLETTER=on astro build --root signals --force && node scripts/signals-check-build.ts && node scripts/signals-og.ts
scripts.signals:build:fixtures: SIGNALS_NEWSLETTER=on SIGNALS_CONTENT=./tests/fixtures/content astro build --root signals --force && node scripts/signals-og.ts
scripts.signals:test:e2e: npm run signals:build:fixtures && playwright test -c signals/playwright.config.ts
scripts.signals:preview:cf: npm run signals:build:review && wrangler dev -c signals/wrangler.jsonc --var NEWSLETTER_PROVIDER:dev
scripts.signals:deploy:preview: npm run signals:build:review && wrangler versions upload -c signals/wrangler.jsonc --preview-alias preview
scripts.signals:deploy: npm run signals:build && wrangler deploy -c signals/wrangler.jsonc
